Janab Assalam-mualayikum, Hum ek kafi bade masale me fhase hue hai, Humne apki Nikkad kitab (english version) padhi hai, Usme Line no.18 per jo masala bayan kar rakha hai, usse talluq rakhta hai. Humne wohi masala Shahi-Bukhari me bhi padha. Janab, hum pichle kayee mahino se apni shadi ke talluq se fiqar ghuza the, or dil jaisi koi ladki nazar me nahi aa rahi thi. Tab achanak Humari Phupu ki ladki jo humari hum umr hain kisis tijarati fiqar se humare yahan rehne aayi. Uski aadatein, soch, taur-tariqee dekh kar woh hume pasand aane lagi, usme woh tammam sifatein hain jo hum apne jode me talsh kar rahe they, Hum apni yeh pasand apne walidaein ko pesh karnehi wale they ki Shahi-Bukahri ke supplement per nazar gayi. jo Line no. hum pehle bayan kar rakhe hain. Jo wakiya usme bayan hua hai, hum wahi galti apne umr ki 13 weh saal me kar baithein hai, Hum apne nafz ke hathon kaid ho rakhe thein or raat k waqt humne apni phupu ko galat intension se unke jism ko hath lagaya. Yeh galti 2-3 martaba ho chuki humse Is baat ko ab 13 saal ho chuke hain, Ab bataur Allah Hukum, hum unki ladki se nikaah nahi kar sakte, Per hume woh ladki kafi pasand hai, Kya is galti ki koi iscilah nahi ho sakti, taki hum usse nikah kar sakein. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 5720 Country: Pakistan Title: My husband want to drink my breast milk. i m his wife. plz repy me that can i give her my milk? he is so insisting but i m not agree with him. Question: My husband want to drink my breast milk. i m his wife. plz repy me that can i give her my milk? he is so insisting but i m not agree with him. Answer ID: 5720 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 323/323=M/1429) It is haram for husband to drink the milk of her wife and obeying husband in unlawful matters is not lawful: لا طاعۃ لمخلوق فی معصیۃ الخالق۔ Therefore, you must not let your husband to drink your milk. If he does so forcefully he will be sinful. Tell him this ruling and show him this fatwa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
